newsitem.title: UK: Granada up on bid denial, demerger report.
newsitem.headline: Granada up on bid denial, demerger report.

text.p: Shares in Granada Group Plc fell in early trade on Thursday, after a denial of rumours of a bid for French hotel chain Accor that hit the shares yesterday and reports that it may demerge its media and hotels operations.
The stock was up 5p at 887-1/2 by 0805 GMT, after yesterday dropping 10p.

A Granada spokesman said late yesterday the company had no plans to bid for Accor, while a report in the Financial Times said the company was likely to demerge its television and media interests as early as the middle of next year.

The Financial Times Lex column said Granada's Forte purchase had produced "hardly impressive" returns but if a demerger "... creates two highly focused high growth businesses that should do wonders for Granada shares."

A spokeswoman for Granada restated comments by chairman Gerry Robinson yesterday that a demerger was possible in the longer term but the group had no plans for such a move in the short-to-medium term.
